title: Rosario to Vampire: Tanabata no Miss Youkai Gakuen

roms.name: Japan, English translation patch v1.0 by jjjewel (as tested)

verified: Backgrounds and character art read from the game's own formats (bbg.py, bac.py): on the Thor, 994 of the first 1000 BG tiles the title screens draw and all 41 256-colour character sprites of a dialogue scene (Kotori: body, eyes, mouth) are keys the extraction made. 2026-10-03: logos, opening and title HD after the emulator fix for full-strength blends and zero fades; the title's sprites hit 420/420; 51 of 53 logged 16-colour sprite misses are extracted pieces.
notes: No standard Nitro graphics: BB archives of BBG pictures (tiled 256-colour BGs, extended palettes) and BAC sprite animations (character parts as 256-colour OBJ chunks). The dialogue text is drawn from a custom #FNT font, converted to NFTR for the HD text (fnt.py); the menus, text window, name plates and buttons are 16-colour BAC sprites with their palettes in 36-byte blocks (bac.py).

overrides.why: Character art is anime illustration, as Lufia's portraits: the anime model draws eyes and hair edges cleanly where 4x-UltraSharp sharpens the pixel steps.
